## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.securityContext`.

```cue
// Pod-level securityContext. The schema shape lives in resources/container.cue
// because #ContainerSchema also embeds it (per-container scope).
spec: securityContext: res.#SecurityContextSchema

// Defined in opmodel.dev/catalogs/opm/resources/v1beta1, imported as res.

#SecurityContextSchema: {
	privileged?:   bool
	runAsNonRoot?: bool
	runAsUser?:    int
	runAsGroup?:   int
	fsGroup?:      int
	supplementalGroups?: [...int]
	readOnlyRootFilesystem?:   bool
	allowPrivilegeEscalation?: bool
	capabilities?: {
		add?: [...string]
		drop?: [...string] | ["ALL"]
	}
}
```
